CentralStation.Kevin.1: I always love passing through here!
CentralStation.Kevin.2a: Even after a long day at work, this station always puts me in a good mood.
CentralStation.Kevin.2b: Something about all the bustle and people coming and going just feels alive, you know?
CentralStation.Kevin.3: So where are you off to, friend?
Dialogue.Rockbreaker: Whoo-wee, stand back now! One wrong swing and this fella comes tumbling right for you!
Message.Rockbreaker: It's packed with heavy, oddly shaped tools built for cracking stone. Best to leave it alone.
